title: Meta says it plans to power its Muse AI agent with Wonder, starting with subscribers, and will develop specialized models it "can bring to everyone using Muse" (Robert Hart/The Verge)
summary: Robert Hart / The Verge: Meta says it plans to power its Muse AI agent with Wonder, starting with subscribers, and will develop specialized models it “can bring to everyone using Muse” — Meta says the models compete with the industry's best and will soon power its Muse agent. … Meta is making up for lost time in the AI race.
